## Historical audit — H0195

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/hint-codex-experiments/runs/codex_parallel_12/lanes/codex_parallel_12_lane4/codex_parallel_12_lane4_H_r2/infer_logs/obsidian-linter-auto-table-of-contents/turn_1/trajs.json` (all event references below are to this file). The supplied inventory also reports evaluation and patch metadata; their underlying files are not shown.

| Aspect | Evidence and interpretation |
|---|---|
| Goal | The task identifier suggests work on an Obsidian Linter automatic table of contents. The full task request is not visible, so its precise behavior and acceptance criteria are unknown. The student says the requested Git base was `main`; this is a reported constraint, not independently visible prompt text (main agent event 5, chars [0,839)). |
| Autonomous exploration | The student inspected Git status, branches, remotes and directory contents, then refs and the latest `master` commit (events 1–4, chars [0,694), [0,1248), [0,685), and [0,10102)). Output showed detached HEAD and `master` at `6393b3a`, with no `main` branch or configured remote visible. There was no visible source-code or test exploration. |
| Changes and validation | The student asked permission to branch from `6393b3a` or have `main` supplied and said no changes or commits were made (event 5, [0,839)). No edit, branch creation, commit or test run appears in the trace. The supplied inventory reports a zero-byte patch, 0/41 fail-to-pass tests and 1131/1131 pass-to-pass tests. These are formal evaluation metadata, not a visible student test run or proof of feature correctness. |
| Teacher input | Hint and review paths are listed as available, but their contents and the actual captured system prompt are not supplied. No delivered teacher message or adoption is visible in events 1–5. Availability is not evidence of receipt; the after-round review cannot be input to this round. |
| Outcome | **Empty patch, formally not solved.** The run ended normally after a clarification request, not with a visible technical interruption (top-level metadata, [0,4772)). No algorithm was implemented, so an algorithmic failure cannot be diagnosed. |

**Lessons and uncertainty.** Transferably, checking refs and remotes can establish a real discrepancy before choosing a requested base. Task-specifically, whether `master` was an acceptable substitute for `main` remains unresolved; matching detached HEAD alone does not establish the intended base. The missing request and teacher prompt also prevent determining whether the clarification was required or whether guidance could have supported a different course. This is a software task, not a Scene trace; scene-object, material, pose and rendering checks are not applicable.
